description: GATE-SPEED R5 A2 (D-102): a diff of split registry keys selects the script tests by the changed keys' readers (x-readers, complete by D-100) instead of by the generated aggregate every test of the registry covers; fail closed for a key without readers, a deleted key, a changed _owner.json or an owner that is not split. Off is the rollback: the aggregate selects as before.
